display.purpose: Application name, amount, and strong empty state.

motion.name: platform-ripple
motion.purpose: Immediate touch feedback on the settings action.

components.name: Primary Action
components.description: Full-width settings action with a 48dp minimum target.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 12px; background: #146B5D; color: #FFFFFF; font: 700 15px sans-serif; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #0E554A; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #A8D9CE; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Active Status
components.description: Non-interactive textual confirmation of an operational state.
components.css: .ds-status-active { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #CDEBDD; color: #07583D; font: 700 14px sans-serif; }

components.name: Waiting Status
components.description: Non-interactive textual explanation of an incomplete state.
components.css: .ds-status-waiting { display: inline-block; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: 999px; background: #F6E5C8; color: #724A09; font: 700 14px sans-serif; }

components.name: Readiness Panel
components.description: Neutral tonal container for permission, connection, and recovery.
components.css: .ds-readiness-panel { padding: 18px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; color: #14201D; font: 400 15px sans-serif; } .ds-readiness-panel:focus-within { outline: 3px solid #A8D9CE; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Latest Payment Panel
components.description: Strong tonal container reserved for the newest accepted payment.
components.css: .ds-latest-payment { padding: 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 16px; background: #D5ECE5; color: #14201D; font: 400 15px sans-serif; } .ds-latest-payment small { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; color: #51635E; } .ds-latest-payment strong { display: block; font-size: 28px; }

narrative.overview: QRIS Listener feels like a trustworthy operational record kept beside a merchant's register. The visual system follows Android conventions, uses one teal action family, mineral neutral surfaces, restrained tonal depth, native text scaling, and semantic status labels.
keyCharacteristics: One action color reserved for controls and connected states.
Tonal panels instead of decorative shadows or borders.
Clear empty, active, waiting, disabled, and error states.
Light and dark schemes with the same information hierarchy.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Teal means an action can be taken or the listener is operational; it is not decorative color.

rules.name: The Text Plus Color Rule
rules.body: Active, waiting, and error states always carry explicit text. Color never communicates status alone.

rules.name: The Tonal Ledger Rule
rules.body: A surface earns a distinct tone only when it separates readiness, the newest payment, an empty state, or an error.

dos: Do show access and connection as separate textual states.
Do keep the settings action full width and at least 48dp tall.
Do test light mode, dark mode, and 1.3 font scale on Android.
donts: Don't add fintech gradients, decorative charts, or unrelated account metrics.
Don't communicate payment success or listener readiness through color alone.
Don't hide core content behind fixed viewport heights or system bars.
